messages:
ana (Finance): FYI Emberly AI invoice INV-2026-089 is past due, attempted automated dunning yesterday, no response.
ana (Finance): Amount outstanding $42,300. Last successful payment 2025-11-12, card expired on file.
mike (Acct Exec): I spoke with their finance contact, Tara. They're cashflow tight this month but want to avoid churn. Asked for a one-time 60-day installment.
jess (Customer Success): Tara emailed a draft schedule: 3x monthly payments starting Apr 15 for $14,100 each, plus a note they'll provide a PO for the remaining balance. Said they'll sign a payment plan.
ana (Finance): We need approvals: (1) accept 60-day split, (2) require signed SOW amendment/PA, (3) place account on limited access (read-only) until first payment posts.
collections-bot: Reminder: 3 dunning emails have been sent; next action: manual outreach recommended.
mike (Acct Exec): Can we do it without involving legal? small amount vs churn risk. They are on Dedicated plan.
lee (Legal): If they sign a simple payment agreement, we can onboard it quickly. I need the invoice and the PO. We can expedite review but require explicit late fee waiver approval from Finance.
ana (Finance): Late fees: standard policy is 1.5%/mo. We can offer a one-time waiver if payments hit on schedule and card on file is updated.
payments-ops: Note: ACH attempts will be cheaper but need bank details; their contact prefers card on file.
mike (Acct Exec): Tara said card on file is a company Amex that failed. She can provide new card today.
jess (Customer Success): I'll coordinate with Tara and get a signed agreement + new card by EOD tomorrow.
ana (Finance): OK — conditional plan: (a) sign payment agreement by EOD tomorrow, (b) update card and pay first installment by Apr 15, (c) place account on limited access until first payment posts, (d) waive late fees if conditions met.
mike (Acct Exec): Sounds good. I'll confirm with Tara. If they miss first payment we escalate to collections and consider suspension on day 46.
lee (Legal): Add clause: "failure to pay on schedule may result in service suspension and referral to collections" — standard.
ana (Finance): Please paste the signed agreement and transaction ID in this thread so we have auditable record.
jess (Customer Success): Will do. Setting a follow-up reminder: /remind #finance in 48 hours to check status.
mike (Acct Exec): Quick Q: do we need C-level signoff for this waiver? Amount is ~$42k.
ana (Finance): No, Finance can approve waiver under $50k for renewals. Above that would need CRO.
collections-bot: Action logged: manual outreach scheduled; reminder set for 48h.
mike (Acct Exec): Thanks team. I'll post updates here once Tara sends agreement.
jess (Customer Success): :thumbsup: 
ana (Finance): If we don't get the agreement or payment by Apr 16, escalate to collections and cc Legal.
lee (Legal): Acknowledged.
payments-ops: If a chargeback occurs, flag immediately and hold any refunds.
mike (Acct Exec): Update: Tara just sent a signed PDF and new card last_message_ts=1992346799. Uploading now.
jess (Customer Success): Uploaded signed_agreement_emberly_1992346799.pdf and transaction_attempt_token abcdef123.
ana (Finance): Received. I'll authorize the first capture on Apr 15 and update this thread with transaction ID.
collections-bot: Thread closed for manual monitoring; reopen if payment fails or docs missing.
